title: PRJ-3 — Docs Viewer Project State Delivery
summary: replace Studio Project State with a Docs Viewer three-way reconciliation report and generated Project resolver lookup
content_html:
PRJ-3 — Docs Viewer Project State Delivery

Status And Purpose

Proposed as PRJ-3 after Project documents expose their folder links through the local Manage manifest.

This delivery replaces Studio's Project State machinery with a Docs Viewer report that compares current folders, Project-document metadata, and historical Work folder snapshots. The same normalized refresh publishes the bounded lookup that PRJ-4 will consume.

Complete Outcome

One report-host document in scope dotlineform opens a current three-way reconciliation. It shows exact agreement and drift states, links to matching Project documents, Works, Series, and validated folder targets, and supports an explicit full Refresh.

Known Docs Viewer and Studio mutations update only affected relationship rows after their canonical commits. Full refresh remains available for direct Finder changes and recovery. The report is read-only.

The old /studio/project-state/ route and static Markdown pipeline no longer exist as a second owner.

Fixed Design Notes

  • The three inputs retain different meanings: current physical evidence, user-maintained convenience links, and historical catalogue facts.
  • Folder identity is relative to $DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR/. The initial discovery scan is rooted at projects/, while exact declared Project links elsewhere below the base directory still receive existence and relationship state.
  • Project State normalizes relative folder keys once and publishes report data plus resolver data from one generation.
  • The folder scan observes folder identities, not primary-image completeness.
  • Report open and explicit Refresh perform a full scan so direct Finder changes are visible; no filesystem watcher is introduced.
  • Trusted application mutations default to targeted delta updates.
  • The exact Work observer is server-side after canonical commit and read-only with respect to Studio. It uses current_record, updated_record, and changed_fields, not a browser event or publication transition.
  • The observer responds to existing Work fields by writing derived Docs Viewer state only. It never adds or reads folder_path, rewrites project_folder, or makes the canonical Work commit depend on Project State refresh.
  • project_folder and project_subfolder change topology; title updates displayed Work labels; series_ids updates report enrichment; project_filename and unrelated metadata do not change folder relations.
  • Derived-projection failure never rolls back or repeats a committed Work or document mutation. The prior complete snapshot is retained and marked stale.
  • The Project resolver lookup is Manage-only and unusable as canonical data.

Delivery Discipline

PRJ-3 is inherently larger than PRJ-1 or PRJ-2, so its size must be controlled per sub-delivery rather than hidden in one replacement diff. It should compose the existing canonical readers, Docs Viewer report host, generated-payload writer, and exact post-commit seams around one Project-specific reconciliation model.

PRJ-3.0 must record the exact proposed files and rough production/test diff for PRJ-3.1, PRJ-3.2, and PRJ-3.3 separately. A new generic graph, event bus, reporting platform, repair framework, or rewritten catalogue reader is scope creep and requires its own accepted delivery. Each stage stops at its review checkpoint if the observed diff or dependencies materially exceed the estimate.

Rough Delivery Steps

PRJ-3.0 — Trace And Freeze The Replacement

  • [ ] Trace the existing Studio route, service, report/open APIs, activity integration, Markdown writer/opener, tests, and all consumers of shared image-extension policy.
  • [ ] Freeze normalized folder identity, three input schemas, report rows and states, exact links, snapshot metadata, resolver lookup schema, and stale presentation.
  • [ ] Freeze configured discovery roots separately from the broader base-root containment and exact-existence policy.
  • [ ] Freeze full-refresh triggers, targeted delta shapes, transaction/publish boundary, and mutation failure response.
  • [ ] Record exact files, reused seams, and separate rough production/test diff estimates for PRJ-3.1, PRJ-3.2, and PRJ-3.3 before implementation approval.

Checkpoint: one fixture explains every report state and the precise output rows affected by Work create, edit, move, title change, Series change, delete, Project URL change, and Project document delete.

PRJ-3.1 — Build The Three-Way Producer And Report

  • [ ] Implement the confined folder-only inventory and normalized reconciliation service.
  • [ ] Read Project-document evidence from the customisation-owned Manage manifest and Studio evidence from canonical Works/Series readers.
  • [ ] Atomically publish report and Project resolver payloads from one snapshot.
  • [ ] Register the local report and create its ordinary dotlineform host document.
  • [ ] Render summary, filters, exact links, duplicate/malformed/missing states, explicit Refresh, and contained unavailable/stale states.

PRJ-3.2 — Add Targeted Refresh Hooks

  • [ ] Add one Project State impact classifier at the shared server-side Work committed-mutation boundary.
  • [ ] Route create, save, delete, bulk save, and import through complete exact before/after deltas or the explicit full-rebuild fallback.
  • [ ] Add equivalent exact Project-document metadata/create/delete follow-through.
  • [ ] Update affected subject and reverse-index rows under one atomic snapshot generation.
  • [ ] Preserve the last complete snapshot and report follow-through failure without retrying the canonical mutation.

PRJ-3.3 — Retire Studio Ownership And Verify

  • [ ] Move any still-shared IMAGE_EXTENSIONS policy before deleting the old report module.
  • [ ] Remove or reroute the Studio route, frontend, APIs, activity contract, Markdown generator/opener, generated file, and obsolete tests/config.
  • [ ] Run focused reconciliation, normalization, report, mutation-delta, atomic-publish, stale-state, exact-link, public-isolation, lint, and whitespace checks.
  • [ ] Manually review real agreement, orphan, prospective, stale, duplicate, moved/renamed, empty, error, long-path, and narrow-screen states.
  • [ ] Transfer the shipped report contract to the durable Docs Viewer Reports owner and keep Projects-specific architecture here.

Not In Scope

  • automatic repair or synchronization;
  • mutation controls in the report;
  • primary-image auditing;
  • continuous folder watching;
  • public Project State data; or
  • Resolver Token parsing and rendering, which belongs to PRJ-4.

Completion Evidence

  • Fixture and real-data evidence prove all three input classes and explicit unmatched/duplicate/incomplete states.
  • Targeted update tests show the bounded rows touched for every relevant Work and Project-document mutation class.
  • Full refresh observes direct Finder changes and atomically publishes matching report/lookup generations.
  • Studio has no remaining Project State route, generator, static report, or hidden second implementation.
  • Public projections contain no local folder paths, lookup data, service URL, or report loader.
